newsitem.title: USA: SpaceLabs to acquire Advanced Medical.
newsitem.headline: SpaceLabs to acquire Advanced Medical.

text.p: SpaceLabs Medical Inc Tuesday said it signed a letter of intent to acquire Advanced Medical Systems for about $7 million.
Advanced Medical, located in Hamden, Conn., develops, manufactures and markets fetal monitors and an obstetrical management clinical information system.

The company said the acquisition is expected to be completed by the end of 1996 and a substantial portion of the purchase price will be taken as a one-time charge attributable to the purchase of in-process research and development.
